arguments.value: The agreement lets an approved affiliate place Chase links on its website and earn commissions for approved credit card accounts that come through those links. Chase can accept or reject affiliates, set and change commission terms, and end the agreement at any time. Affiliates must follow strict rules about acceptable site content, privacy policies, keywords, trademarks, links, and marketing methods, and they may not use offensive, illegal, misleading, or restricted content or terms. Chase handles credit card applications and account processing, while the affiliate is responsible for maintaining working links and may be required to indemnify Chase for claims related to the affiliate’s site or breaches of the agreement. Chase disclaims warranties, limits its liability, can modify the agreement by posting updates, and Delaware law governs the agreement.
